candidates.label: Use one 15-minute witness window with one attempt and no retry
evidence: WORK-PACK.md:123 requires a bounded external test window and one-attempt ceiling.

One attempt can bind one OAuth callback, exactly two page-1 activity-list provider calls (GET per_page=12 and evidence-POST revalidation per_page=50), one evidence submission, and supervised disposition.
Any failure can stop without retry and require a new exact external-effect request.

candidates.label: Use one 60-minute witness window with one attempt and no retry
evidence: A 60-minute ceiling is still finite and preserves one-attempt semantics.
It creates a longer credential and evidence exposure window than the 15-minute option.

candidates.label: Permit one automatic retry after provider or validation failure
rejectionReasons: An automatic retry exceeds the Work Pack's one-attempt ceiling and would require a new external-effect graph.

candidates.label: Defer the external window selection
evidence: Deferral performs no provider request and leaves the witness blocked.
